F1 resolution and execution-path review
The prior Sol finding on 6cbed2b5fa95c9556664ff2fab6bbb2517e103a0 was a confirmed P2: a null initial or post-export summary disabled export indefinitely. The second/final bounded repair closes that path. The actual delegated click handler admits an unavailable-state retry, the actual view renders it, and the shared refresh method claims its in-flight guard before awaiting summary. Null/rejection returns to retryable unavailable; healthy summary restores ready/export in the same instance. Export remains separately guarded and its awaited follow-up uses that same refresh path. Disposal stops new requests and prevents late DOM/download effects. Historical export error text remains through summary recovery until the next export. Capture notifications still replace only diagnostics on the fixed 100 ms timer, without summary reads or calibration rebuilds. Real Panel.setContent is deferred; stale visible buttons are additionally protected by synchronous state/ownership guards. The fixture mounts the complete actual subclass and real view while replacing base UI/services; it does not establish installed application behavior.
